name: Shika (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Shika town emblem in blue, green and orange: a blue ring crossed by green and orange stylised strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Shika, a town in Ishikawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 September 2005.

features.role: Shika town emblem — a blue ring crossed by green and orange stylised strokes
